description: This file defines the 'Shape' class within the AWS SDK for PHP, representing a modeled shape with methods to create instances based on definitions, retrieve type and name information, and access a context parameter.

classes.name: Shape
classes.description: Represents a modeled shape in the AWS SDK, providing factory methods for shape instantiation and accessors for shape properties.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates an instance of a specific shape subclass based on the provided definition and shape map.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of the shape.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the shape.

methods.name: getContextParam
methods.description: Returns the context parameter associated with the shape.
